svg.title: Jarvis Disc Mk I speaker and chamber
svg.text: Speaker and chamber: placement, sealed volume, expected response (taller plinth)
Volumes are estimates; the driver depth (32) is not confirmed, check the datasheet drawing
A. SECTION THROUGH THE CENTRE: SEALED CHAMBER
sound leaves through the 3 mm gap under the plinth
seals the 24 mm hole in the floor
in the ring around the driver
B. PLAN VIEW OF THE PLINTH, LID OFF (FRONT AT THE BOTTOM)
Grey disc = driver flange with its 6 mounting holes on a 66 circle; dashed gold = Ø50 opening in the plinth floor;
dark green = controller and amp boards standing on edge; the 3 M3 posts moved out to r 40.5 and merge into the neck wall.
minus driver body in the chamber
The cone breathes into the 3 mm gap under the plinth, the back into this chamber.
Qtc 0.7 is flat. This driver stays below 0.7 in this chamber, so there is no boom to EQ away.
Expect a clean desk speaker down to about 230 Hz: fuller than the Adafruit 3351, still not a bass speaker.
Optional firmware: a gentle +3 dB low shelf near 200 Hz, and a high-pass at 150 Hz to protect the cone.
D. SPEAKER CHOICE: BLAM AUDIO FRS 2N50 (4 OHM)
50 mm full range, neodymium, kevlar cone, 4 ohm, 25 W nominal (50 W max)
Sensitivity 87 dB (2.83 V, 1 m), Re 3.8 ohm, 250 Hz to 22 kHz as rated
Sd 16.6 cm2, Xmax 2 mm, Mms 1.8 g, BL 3.6 Tm
Fs 120 Hz, Qts 0.37, Vas 0.37 L: suits a small sealed box
Frame 73.5 round, 6 holes on a 66 circle, cutout 52 printed on the drawing
Depth: the datasheet drawing is an image; I read 32 as the depth but could not confirm it.
If it is deeper than 32, add the difference to the plinth lift in jarvis_disc.scad (lift = 16.5).
Hole size and exact cutout: read them off the drawing, then adjust the floor bosses.
Maker: blam-audio.com (France). Ask for price, stock and a full drawing.
SEAL EVERYTHING, THE BOX MUST BE AIRTIGHT
Cable hole in the body floor: foam plug or grommet around the wires
Body-to-neck joint: 1 mm closed-cell foam ring or a bead of silicone
USB-C slot and mute-button hole: silicone or hot glue around the part
Driver flange: 0.5 mm foam gasket, six screws pull it down evenly
Slit under the plinth: 327 mm x 3 mm = about 980 mm2 against a 1660 mm2 cone, so some top-end loss. Feet of 6 mm (+3 mm overall) give 1960 mm2 and remove it.
jarvis_disc.scad is updated (lift 16.5, round 50 opening, posts at r 40.5) but the STL files are not re-exported: OpenSCAD is not installed on this machine.
